fonte_hash_sql: SELECT p.proname||'('||pg_catalog.oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes)||')' AS sig,  md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_md5,  length(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))::text AS definition_len,  coalesce(p.proacl::text,'') AS acl,  coalesce(p.proconfig::text,'') AS proconfig FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public';
